import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud vs non-fraud
fraud_palette = {0: '#2ecc71', 1: '#e74c3c'}
fraud_labels = {0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'}

# 1. Distribution of transaction amounts by fraud status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]['amount']
    ax1.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=fraud_labels[fraud_status], 
             color=fraud_palette[fraud_status], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Fraud rate by transaction type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = (fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count']) * 100
fraud_by_type = fraud_by_type.sort_values('fraud_rate', ascending=True)

bars = ax2.barh(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'], 
                color=sns.color_palette('RdYlGn_r', len(fraud_by_type)), edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(fraud_by_type.iterrows()):
    ax2.text(row['fraud_rate'] + 0.5, i, f'{row["fraud_rate"]:.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlim(0, max(fraud_by_type['fraud_rate']) * 1.2)
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud distribution by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_data = df.groupby(['hour_of_day', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_data.columns = [fraud_labels[col] for col in hourly_data.columns]
hourly_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=[fraud_palette[0], fraud_palette[1]], 
                 edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, width=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Transaction Status')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=8)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box plot of amount by transaction type and fraud status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_status'] = df['is_fraud'].map(fraud_labels)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_status', 
            ax=ax4, palette=[fraud_palette[0], fraud_palette[1]])
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add summary statistics as text
total_transactions = len(df)
fraud_count = df['is_fraud'].sum()
fraud_rate = (fraud_count / total_transactions) * 100

plt.figtext(0.5, 0.02, 
            f'Summary: {total_transactions:,} total transactions | {fraud_count:,} fraudulent ({fraud_rate:.1f}%) | Average amount: ${df["amount"].mean():.2f}',
            ha='center', fontsize=11, style='italic', 
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='lightgray', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
